findings.current: nearly twenty people had been carried to the medical clinic
findings.defect: The source says the number carried to the clinic reached twenty (스무 명에 달한다), not that it was nearly twenty.
findings.rationale: The source’s quantity expression 달한다 indicates reaching twenty; “nearly” places the count below twenty.
findings.replacement: twenty people had been carried to the medical clinic

findings.current: Everyone seemed to understand that provoking Jeok Cheongang right now would be a bad idea.
findings.defect: The source adds that this was understood even without the narrator’s involvement or prompting. The assembled line drops that contrast, which the accepted baseline preserved.
findings.rationale: 굳이 내가 아니어도 means the narrator need not be the one to point it out; the martial artists themselves understood not to provoke Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement: And it seemed everyone understood that, even without me, provoking Jeok Cheongang in his current mood was a bad idea.

summary: The assembled copy is largely faithful, but it understates one quantity and drops a narrator-side contrast preserved in the source and accepted baseline.
